params.name: vpAreaName
params.description: 4D View Pro area form object name

params.name: rowCount
params.description: Total number of rows to set; must be greater than 0

sentinelValues.meaning: Explicitly designates the current spreadsheet (same as omitting sheet).

overloads.semanticRole: The VP SET ROW COUNT command defines the total number of rows in vpAreaName .

constraints: If vpAreaName does not exist, an error is returned.
